text:
Megan: Quick sync — launching the benchmarks content hub next week. Need to lock keywords, schema, internal linking plan, and the redirect map for old blog posts.
Alex: 👍 I updated the seed keyword list in the spreadsheet. Top priorities: 'LLM inference cost', 'low-latency LLM serving', 'GPU inference best practices'.
Sophia: Can you paste the spreadsheet link? I'll audit the semantic clusters for the hub.
Alex: https://docs.google.com/xyz — look at the 'benchmarks' tab. I've added search volume and intent tags.
Tom: For schema, let's use Article + FAQ schema on pillar pages, and Product/SoftwareApplication schema for feature pages. Also add Speakable for the webinar summary?
Megan: Good call. FAQ schema on the hub landing + sample Q/A per benchmark. Tom — can you draft JSON-LD snippets?
Tom: Yep. Will push examples in the next message.
Tom: ```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [
    {"@type": "Question","name": "How do you measure LLM inference cost?","acceptedAnswer": {"@type": "Answer","text": "We compute TCO per 1M tokens using throughput profiles across GPU families..."}}
  ]
}
```
Sophia: That looks fine. We should also include 'sameAs' links for benchmark methodology repo and embed the benchmark CSV as a downloadable dataset (schema: DataDownload).
Megan: Redirects — critical. We have ~12 legacy posts that will be consolidated. I sketched a redirect map; need engineering to implement in the next deploy window.
Alex: Here's a compact redirect list — we'll canonicalize to the hub pages.
SEOBot: Redirect map validation: 12 entries, 0 conflicts detected.
Alex: ```
# old_path,new_path,reason
/blog/llm-cost-v1,/benchmarks/llm-inference-cost,consolidate
/blog/kv-cache-guide,/benchmarks/kv-cache,merge
/product/old-routing-guide,/docs/routing-policy,redirect
/blog/low-latency-tips,/benchmarks/latency,merge
/blog/quantization-explained,/benchmarks/quantization,canonicalize
/blog/old-embed-guide,/benchmarks/embeddings,consolidate
/blog/model-selection-tips,/benchmarks/model-selection,merge
/blog/onnx-optimizations,/benchmarks/onnx,redirect
/blog/legacy-benchmark-2019,/benchmarks/archive,archive-redirect
/blog/serve-best-practices,/benchmarks/serving,merge
/blog/old-gpu-compare,/benchmarks/gpu-comparison,consolidate
/blog/deprecated-qa,/benchmarks/faq,redirect
```
Megan: Perfect. Two asks for eng: (1) implement 301s, preserve UTM query strings, (2) add header for 'x-redirect-source' for tracking in logs.
Alex: I'll file a ticket in Jira and ping infra.
Sophia: Internal linking: pillar -> benchmark pages -> webinar landing -> docs. We should include contextual CTAs that point to the webinar sign-up and the benchmark CSV download. Also add structured data `potentialAction` to webinar landing for Event signups.
Tom: For monitoring, add GA4 event for redirect hits + Logstash pipeline to capture x-redirect-source. I'll coordinate with SRE.
Megan: Copy for the hub launch post: short hero, methodology, key findings, CTA to webinar and to 'Try Redwood Inference' with a small interactive cost calculator. Drafting now, will share by EOD.
Alex: SEO checklist before publish: 1) meta titles (include primary keyword), 2) canonical tags, 3) structured data validation, 4) redirects in staging applied and smoke-tested, 5) internal links added, 6) sitemap update + robots.txt review, 7) monitor crawl errors in Search Console.
Sophia: I'll run a Screaming Frog crawl after staging deploy.
Megan: Schedule: staging deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT, go/no-go review at 13:00 PT, production deploy Wed 02:00 PT.
Tom: I added a small Lighthouse performance task — reduce hub hero images, lazy-load charts.
Alex: One more: add hreflang? Not needed for this US-first launch, but note for APAC follow-up.
Megan: Great team. I'll write the Jira ticket for redirects and add the schema snippets Tom shared. Any blockers?
Sophia: None from content side.
Tom: No blockers.
SEOBot: Reminder: run structured data tester after deploy: https://search.google.com/test/rich-results
Megan: Thanks — closing thread. :tada:
